== Original Virtual Set 11 published English card text ==
The Gold slip boosts each non-Jedi Skywalker’s defense value and destiny by 2 and searches for one twice per game. The remaster omits those bonuses and gives a paid search during the opponent’s control phase for Leia or non-Jedi Luke. Both retain the pilot bonus, end-of-turn Force loss and reduction if Vader is on table. Regular and alternate v17 art carry the same remaster text.
